verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Replit's AI Agent building/publishing workflow, deployments, integrations, and design tooling, but contains no explicit documentation of a code editor or file view where a developer can directly open and hand-edit the generated source files. Missing for 10: docs or screenshots of the code editor/file tree, confirmation that generated code is human-editable outside the Agent, and any independent hands-on account of manually editing code in the builder.
